rules.identity: Existing sourceIdentity: strip fragment and trailing slash, remove utm_*/ref/referrer/fbclid/gclid/msclkid, sort remaining query keys; preserve semantic queries. Existing humanSourceUrl aliases OpenAI and Ideogram .md to HTML. Navigation/evidence URLs unchanged.
rules.title: One role · site · page per normalized URL. URL-wide readable title outranks card spelling and list position. Non-fal: frozen unscoped title, meaningful namespace/region/language qualifier when needed, then sorted strict readable candidates; omit card-specific dates/aliases. Numeric release codes stay in the model subject. Hidden Runware schema JSON attribution uses the parent model plus API 规格.
rules.fal: Fal is always 渠道资料. API title uses the longest matching catalog endpoint name, normalizing slug separators/case without changing picker names, plus remaining endpoint segments and API 文档. If no catalog identity matches, retain the existing unscoped subject. Example: 渠道资料 · fal · FLUX 2 Pro API 文档; edit: 渠道资料 · fal · FLUX 2 Pro Edit API 文档.
rules.role: Vendor documentation and vendor repositories: 官方文档. Fal, TokenDance, Replicate, Fireworks, Novita, Runware, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Together and Tencent MaaS: 渠道资料. Alibaba/Baidu/Volcengine/Tencent hosted pages: 渠道资料 except paths naming their own Qwen/QVQ/Wan/Tongyi, ERNIE, Doubao/Seedream/Seedance or Hunyuan family: 官方文档. Retirement notices keep 下线公告. Field provenance is separate; catalog/product explanations precede the canonical title with a colon.
rules.occurrences: Count each Web footer link, dialog link, distinct title per input/output dialog field, each titled icon tooltip, and retirement dialog. Mini counts every footer/source-copy button and its dialog, distinct field title, each titled icon tooltip and retirement source. Accessibility mirrors the tooltip and is checked but not counted again. Verification dates and provenance explanations are not part of the title.
